capability: Rules on paper are advice; a check can stop the merge
title: Turn each rule into a door.

hook.picture: Close on the whale holding up a long paper scroll of rules beside the line; the line wobbles past it.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: We wrote the rules down. The AI ignored them.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: the scroll stands beside the line like a sign; lines pass it, some wobbly, and nothing stops them. Three-times device: three lines pass the scroll, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, each wobbling a little more.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Paper asks. Nothing makes it stop.

stakes.body: Teams lose trust in the AI and in their own rules, and review turns into rereading everything.

solution_hint: Turn each rule into a check.

metaphor.body: A rule on a scroll is a sign by the road. Torn off and planted on the line, it becomes a door the work has to pass through.

steps.picture: The whale tears one line off the scroll and plants it on the line, where it grows into a small gate.
steps.words: Turn each rule into a check.

steps.picture: The wobbly line hits the gate and stops; the whale smooths it; it passes, and a tick drops.
Two more scroll lines become gates; the scroll shrinks as the row of gates grows, and each pass drops a tick.
The row of gates gets its name.
steps.words: Each rule that stops work: a gate.

real_case.claim: The craft README says rules written as prose get far lower compliance than mechanical gates, but it gives no source for its figures, so they stay off screen and the card says Illustration. Its /senior-review gate "can block a merge alongside a CI check".

honest_limit.picture: A smooth line passes every gate, but it is wildly over-built: a huge loop that no gate measures.
honest_limit.words: No check for it? It walks through.

not_this.body: A gate only checks what you wrote.

ending_pattern.body: FELT framing returns. The whale holds up the scroll and it folds into a row of small gates on the line; the next line passes straight through; the pod answers ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: The scroll the line wobbled past in bar 1 is now the gates it passes through, same framing.

end_belief.body: If it matters, make it a check.
